Apple___Apple_scab.treatment: Apply fungicides containing captan or sulfur. Remove infected leaves and fallen fruit.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Ensure good air circulation. Avoid overhead watering.

Apple___Black_rot.treatment: Prune infected branches. Apply fungicide sprays during the growing season.
Apple___Black_rot.prevention: Remove mummified fruit. Improve drainage. Use resistant cultivars.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.treatment: Apply fungicides in early spring. Remove nearby cedar trees if possible.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.prevention: Plant resistant apple varieties. Maintain tree health with proper fertilization.

Apple___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Continue regular care.
Apple___healthy.prevention: Maintain good practices: proper watering, fertilization, and pruning.

Blueberry___healthy.prevention: Ensure acidic soil (pH 4.5-5.5). Mulch and water regularly.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.treatment: Apply sulfur or neem oil sprays. Prune to improve air circulation.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Avoid overhead watering. Plant in sunny locations.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.treatment: Apply fungicides if severe. Remove crop debris after harvest.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.prevention: Rotate crops. Use resistant hybrids. Avoid dense planting.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.treatment: Usually not economical to treat. Plant resistant varieties.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.treatment: Apply fungicides for severe infections. Remove infected debris.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.prevention: Crop rotation. Resistant hybrids. Avoid excessive nitrogen.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.prevention: Balanced fertilization. Proper spacing for air circulation.

Grape___Black_rot.treatment: Apply fungicides from bud break to harvest. Remove mummified fruit.
Grape___Black_rot.prevention: Prune for air circulation. Remove infected plant material.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).treatment: No effective chemical treatment. Prune infected wood.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).prevention: Avoid wounding vines. Use clean pruning tools.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.treatment: Apply copper-based fungicides. Remove infected leaves.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.prevention: Ensure good drainage. Avoid overhead irrigation.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).treatment: No cure available. Remove infected trees to prevent spread.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).prevention: Control psyllid insects. Use disease-free nursery stock.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper sprays. Remove severely infected trees.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Avoid overhead watering.

Peach___healthy.prevention: Proper pruning and thinning of fruit.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper-based bactericides. Remove infected plants.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use disease-free seeds. Rotate crops. Avoid overhead watering.

Potato___Early_blight.treatment: Apply fungicides containing chlorothalonil. Remove infected foliage.
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Crop rotation. Use certified disease-free seed potatoes.

Potato___Late_blight.treatment: Apply fungicides immediately. Destroy infected plants.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Avoid overhead irrigation. Good air circulation.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.treatment: Apply sulfur or potassium bicarbonate sprays. Remove heavily infected leaves.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Ensure good air circulation.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.treatment: Remove infected leaves. Apply fungicides if severe.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.prevention: Use resistant varieties. Avoid overhead watering.

Strawberry___healthy.prevention: Mulch plants. Remove old leaves in spring.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper-based sprays. Remove infected plants.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use disease-free transplants. Avoid overhead watering. Crop rotation.

Tomato___Early_blight.treatment: Apply fungicides containing chlorothalonil or copper. Remove lower infected leaves.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Mulch plants. Water at base. Stake plants for air circulation.

Tomato___Late_blight.treatment: Apply fungicides immediately. Remove and destroy infected plants.
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Avoid wetting foliage. Good air circulation.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.treatment: Improve ventilation. Apply fungicides if needed.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.prevention: Space plants properly. Avoid high humidity. Prune lower leaves.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.treatment: Apply fungicides. Remove infected lower leaves.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.prevention: Mulch to prevent soil splash. Rotate crops. Remove debris.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.treatment: Spray with water to dislodge mites. Use insecticidal soap or neem oil.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.prevention: Maintain adequate moisture. Avoid over-fertilizing with nitrogen.

Tomato___Target_Spot.treatment: Apply fungicides. Remove infected plant parts.
Tomato___Target_Spot.prevention: Crop rotation. Avoid overhead watering. Good air circulation.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.treatment: No cure. Remove infected plants. Control whiteflies.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.prevention: Use reflective mulches. Plant resistant varieties. Control whitefly populations.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.treatment: No cure available. Remove and destroy infected plants.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.prevention: Use disease-free seeds. Wash hands after handling tobacco. Disinfect tools.

Tomato___healthy.prevention: Proper spacing. Staking. Regular watering and fertilization.
